title: 4D-AIKit providers (AIProviders.json)
description: Providers and model aliases consumed by cs.AIKit.OpenAIProviders.

providers.description: Map of provider name -> connection config.

models.description: Map of model-alias name -> { provider, model }. Referenced by embeddings.json > definitions[].modelAlias.

baseURL.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1/

apiKey.description: Secret key. Prefer leaving empty and using the <PROVIDER>_API_KEY env var.

provider.description: Must be a key of the top-level 'providers' object.
